name: orchestration
description: Orchestrator agent that delegates to researcher, implementer, integrator and reviewer agents with test and review gates, plus a /route skill that sizes a task first.

test_cmd.title: Test command
test_cmd.description: Command the test gate runs instead of the detected one (ORCH_TEST_CMD).

escalation.title: Opus review escalation
escalation.description: Empty: opus review for slices with a doubt signal; off or always (ORCH_ESCALATION).

judge.title: Bash judge
judge.description: Empty: off; native turns on the deny-only Bash judge hook (ORCH_JUDGE).

judge_timeout_ms.title: Bash judge timeout (ms)
judge_timeout_ms.description: How long the Bash judge may take, capped at 45000 (ORCH_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS).

read_router.title: Read router
read_router.description: Empty: off; on picks the reading model for researchers by file type (ORCH_READ_ROUTER).

gap_min.title: Gap cutoff
gap_min.description: Reviewer gap confidence at or above which a review fails, default 80 (ORCH_GAP_MIN).

stall_gate.title: Stall gate
stall_gate.description: Empty: on; off stops requiring a replan for a stalled slice (ORCH_STALL_GATE).

guards.title: Researcher and egress guards
guards.description: Empty: on; off disables the researcher Bash and reviewer WebFetch guards (ORCH_GUARDS).

allow_builtins.title: Allow built-in subagents
allow_builtins.description: Empty: blocked during a run; 1 allows built-in and fork subagents (ORCH_ALLOW_BUILTINS).

run_stale_min.title: Run stale after (minutes)
run_stale_min.description: Minutes without activity before an open run counts as stale, default 30 (ORCH_RUN_STALE_MIN).

baseline.title: Test baseline
baseline.description: inform (default), allow or off: compare failing tests with the base (ORCH_BASELINE).

bugfix_check.title: Bugfix check
bugfix_check.description: Empty: on; off skips the KIND: bugfix reproduction test check (ORCH_BUGFIX_CHECK).

quote_check.title: Quote check
quote_check.description: Empty: on; off skips checking researcher QUOTE lines against their sources (ORCH_QUOTE_CHECK).

gate_isolated.title: Test gate in worktrees
gate_isolated.description: Test gate in isolated worktrees: warn (default), block or skip (ORCH_GATE_ISOLATED).

skill_hints.title: Skill hints
skill_hints.description: Empty: on; off drops the plan check's suggested-skills block for worker launches (ORCH_SKILL_HINTS).
